svg.title: Pipeline diagram for KV compression, token selection, and sparse attention with fused recover kernel
svg.desc: Inventory and construction order: the full figure contains a left pre-rope Query/Key block, Stage 1 offline calibration and KV compression with a covariance/EVD sub-flow, a central latent key cache and token selection path with selected dimensions and approximate attention score, a Top-k index and transpose connection, a fused recover kernel rounded dashed frame with reconstructed RoPE and multiplication, then post-rope Query/Key stacks and an FA block. The composition is horizontally staged with dotted stage arrows along the bottom and a top rope route from the input query to the post-rope query. Symmetry/equipartition basis: repeated tensor stacks use equal-width/equal-height grid partitions; the three stages are laid out left-to-right along a common baseline, and the fused kernel groups vertical columns and horizontal rows around a central multiplication operation. SAM mappings used after construction: Original multiplication/circled-cross in fused kernel - constructed element draft_mult_kernel - asset_sam_region_000053; Original multiplication/circled-cross near central query-key product - constructed element draft_mult_left - asset_sam_region_000054.
